brief:
Israeli occupation forces surrounded a house in the Diriya area of Akraba village south of Nablus on Tuesday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The troops issued an ultimatum to an occupant inside the building, demanding immediate surrender and warning they would demolish the structure if the demand was refused.

The siege followed the forces firing a projectile toward the house. The operation marked another instance of Israeli military activity in the northern West Bank region. No immediate information was available regarding the identity of the person Israeli forces sought or the specific circumstances that triggered the early morning operation in the Palestinian village.
